report_contract.title: Sites Status Report
strategic_advise_guidance: Prioritize completion of new outposts to expand resource access.
Monitor population distribution to ensure adequate support at all sites.
Rotate resource extraction to prevent site depletion and maintain sustainability.
Consider reactivating dormant sites as demand increases.
report_contract.format_standards: Always use the combined INIT+ID format (e.g., AGEX-1-2) for Initiative references in reports. Never separate initiative code and ID into different columns or fields.
